mapper.select:
select p.pest_id, p.record_id, p.image_id, p.pest_name, p.pest_code, p.pest_crop, p.pest_confidence, p.pest_count, p.pest_total_count, p.pest_result, p.pest_advice, p.pest_result_img_url, p.bbox_json, p.is_warning, p.warning_level, p.pest_a, p.pest_b, p.pest_c, p.pest_d, p.pest_e, p.pest_f, p.pest_g, p.pest_h, p.pest_i, p.pest_j,
img.image_name, img.image_url, coalesce(r.park_id, img.park_id) as park_id, coalesce(r.plot_id, img.plot_id) as area_id, img.image_b as location_id, coalesce(r.device_id, img.device_id) as device_id,
r.record_no, r.record_mode, r.record_status,
pk.park_name, a.area_name, l.location_name, d.device_name from xwq_ai_pest p left join xwq_ai_image img on img.image_id = p.image_id left join xwq_ai_record r on r.record_id = p.record_id left join iot_device d on img.device_id = d.device_id left join location l on img.image_b = cast(l.location_id as char) left join area a on img.plot_id = a.area_id left join park pk on coalesce(r.park_id, img.park_id) = pk.park_id
and p.pest_id in
#{pestId}
and p.record_id = #{recordId} and p.image_id = #{imageId} and p.pest_name like concat('%', #{pestName}, '%') and p.pest_code = #{pestCode} and p.pest_crop = #{pestCrop} and p.pest_confidence = #{pestConfidence} and p.pest_count = #{pestCount} and p.pest_total_count = #{pestTotalCount} and p.pest_result = #{pestResult} and p.pest_advice = #{pestAdvice} and p.is_warning = #{isWarning} and p.warning_level = #{warningLevel} and p.pest_a = #{pestA}
and coalesce(r.park_id, img.park_id) = #{parkId} and coalesce(r.plot_id, img.plot_id) = #{areaId} and img.image_b = #{locationId} and img.device_id = #{deviceId}
and str_to_date(left(p.pest_a, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') >= str_to_date(#{params.startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and str_to_date(left(p.pest_a, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') <= str_to_date(#{params.endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
order by p.pest_id desc
